```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// GitHub Pages serves this page at the URL that failed, so the pathname is the broken address.
path = decodeURIComponent(location.pathname)

siteIndex = fetch("/assets/data/site-index.json").then(r => r.json())

norm = s => s.toLowerCase().replace(/\.html?$/, "").replace(/\/index$/, "").replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, "")
words = s => norm(s).split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter(w => w && w !== "index" && w !== "www")
lev = (a, b) => {
  const m = Array.from({length: a.length + 1}, (_, i) => [i]);
  for (let j = 1; j <= b.length; j++) m[0][j] = j;
  for (let i = 1; i <= a.length; i++)
    for (let j = 1; j <= b.length; j++)
      m[i][j] = Math.min(m[i-1][j] + 1, m[i][j-1] + 1, m[i-1][j-1] + (a[i-1] === b[j-1] ? 0 : 1));
  return m[a.length][b.length];
}
sim = (a, b) => (a || b) ? 1 - lev(a, b) / Math.max(a.length, b.length) : 0
simk = (g, k) => g.length >= 4 && k.includes(g) ? Math.max(sim(g, k), 0.85) : sim(g, k)

scored = {
  const segs = norm(path).split("/").filter(Boolean);
  const cands = segs.filter(g => g.length >= 4).length ? segs.filter(g => g.length >= 4) : segs;
  const first = segs[0] || "";
  const wanted = new Set(words(path));
  const rows = siteIndex.map(d => {
    const keys = [norm(d.title), norm(d.id), norm(new URL(d.url, location.origin).pathname).split("/").pop()];
    const s = Math.max(...cands.flatMap(g => keys.map(k => simk(g, k) * (g === cands[cands.length - 1] ? 1 : 0.65))), 0);
    const dw = new Set([...words(d.title), ...words(d.id)]);
    const overlap = [...wanted].filter(w => dw.has(w)).length / (new Set([...wanted, ...dw]).size || 1);
    const bonus = first && d.url.startsWith("/" + first + "/") ? 0.15 : 0;
    const isParent = d.url !== "/" && path.startsWith(d.url) ? -0.08 : 0;
    return {...d, score: 0.65 * s + 0.2 * overlap + bonus + isParent};
  }).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score).slice(0, 5);
  const u = rows.map(r => 7 * r.score), mx = Math.max(...u);
  const den = u.reduce((t, x) => t + Math.exp(x - mx), 0);
  return rows.map((r, i) => ({...r, p: Math.exp(u[i] - mx) / den}));
}

// The map's stations are the site's sections. Work out which one is nearest to the best guess.
stations = [
  {name: "Home", url: "/"}, {name: "Explore", url: "/explore/"}, {name: "Models", url: "/models/"},
  {name: "Reports", url: "/reports/"}, {name: "Data", url: "/data/"}, {name: "Code", url: "/code/"},
  {name: "Updates", url: "/updates/"}, {name: "About", url: "/about.html"}
]
stationOf = d => {
  const byUrl = {"/": "Home", "/explore/": "Explore", "/reports/": "Reports", "/data/": "Data", "/code/": "Code",
    "/updates/": "Updates", "/about.html": "About", "/contact/": "About", "/license/": "About"};
  if (d.kind === "Page") return d.url.startsWith("/models/") ? "Models" : (byUrl[d.url] || "Home");
  if (["App", "Map"].includes(d.kind)) return "Explore";
  if (d.kind === "Data") return "Data";
  if (d.kind === "Model") return "Models";
  if (["Estimation", "Calibration", "Validation", "Input data", "Post-processing", "Scenario", "Geography", "Development", "Analysis"].includes(d.kind)) return "Reports";
  return "Code";
}
targetStation = Math.max(0, stations.findIndex(s => s.name === stationOf(scored[0])))

legacyTarget = [
  [/^\/1-tdm\//, "/models/tdm.html", "Travel Demand Model"],
  [/^\/2-remm\//, "/models/remm.html", "Real-Estate Market Model"],
  [/^\/3-bdm\//, "/models/bdm.html", "Bike Demand Model"],
  [/^\/4-tools\//, "/explore/", "Explore"]
].find(([re]) => re.test(path))
redirect = (legacyTarget
  ? {url: legacyTarget[1], name: legacyTarget[2], why: "This page has moved.", seconds: 3}
  : (scored[0].p > 0.75 && scored[0].score > 0.6 && scored[0].url.startsWith("/")
      ? {url: scored[0].url, name: scored[0].title, why: "That looks like a typo.", seconds: 6} : null))

reduceMotion = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
shortPath = path.length > 34 ? "…" + path.slice(-33) : path
issueUrl = "https://github.com/WFRCAnalytics/wfrcanalytics.github.io/issues/new?title=" +
  encodeURIComponent("Broken link: " + path) + "&body=" +
  encodeURIComponent("Page requested: " + location.href + "\nCame from: " + (document.referrer || "(typed or bookmarked)"))
lostModule = import("/assets/js/lost-map.js")
```

::: {.column-screen}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const best = stations[targetStation];
  const root = html`<section class="lost" aria-labelledby="lost-title">
    <div class="lost-card">
      <p class="lost-eyebrow">Error 404 · Route not found</p>
      <h1 id="lost-title">Well, this is <span class="accent">off the map.</span></h1>
      <p><code class="lost-path">${shortPath}</code> is not on any route we serve. The nearest station to where you were headed is
        <strong>${best.name}</strong>.</p>
      <p class="lost-actions">
        <a class="btn btn-primary" href="${scored[0].url}" target="${scored[0].url.startsWith("http") ? "_blank" : null}">Take me to ${scored[0].title}</a>
        <a class="btn btn-outline-primary" href="/">Home</a></p>
      <p class="lost-actions">
        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" type="button" data-poster>Save this map as an image</button>
        <a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" href="${issueUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Report the broken link</a></p>
      <p class="lost-note">Every broken address draws its own terrain. This one is yours.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="lost-stage"></div>
  </section>`;
  const mod = await lostModule;
  const map = mod.createLostMap({d3, stage: root.querySelector(".lost-stage"), seedText: path, stations, target: targetStation, reduceMotion});
  root.querySelector("[data-poster]").onclick = async () => {
    const blob = await map.poster("Off the map: " + shortPath, "Nearest station: " + best.name + " · Wasatch Front Regional Council Analytics");
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = "off-the-map.png"; a.click();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 2000);
  };
  invalidation.then(() => map.destroy());
  return root;
}
```

::: {.wfrc-band-alt .column-screen}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  if (!redirect) return html``;
  let left = redirect.seconds;
  const el = html`<div class="redirect-strip" role="region" aria-label="Automatic redirect">
    <span class="redirect-text">${redirect.why} Taking you to <strong>${redirect.name}</strong> in <span class="redirect-count" aria-hidden="true">${left}</span> seconds.</span>
    <a class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" href="${redirect.url}">Go now</a>
    <button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" type="button">Stay here</button></div>`;
  const count = el.querySelector(".redirect-count");
  const id = setInterval(() => { left -= 1; count.textContent = left; if (left <= 0) location.replace(redirect.url); }, 1000);
  el.querySelector("button").onclick = () => { clearInterval(id); el.querySelector(".redirect-text").textContent = "Okay, you can stay here and look around."; el.querySelectorAll("a, button").forEach(x => x.remove()); };
  invalidation.then(() => clearInterval(id));
  return el;
}
```

## Or search the site

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof query = html`<input type="search" class="form-control notfound-search" placeholder="Search tools, models and pages" aria-label="Search tools, models and pages" autocomplete="off">`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!q) return html`<p class="suggest-note">Type a few letters to see matches.</p>`;
  const hits = siteIndex.filter(d => (d.title + " " + d.id).toLowerCase().includes(q)).slice(0, 8);
  if (!hits.length) return html`<p class="suggest-note">Nothing matches “${query}”.</p>`;
  return html`<ul class="suggest">${hits.map(d => html`<li><a href="${d.url}" target="${d.url.startsWith("http") ? "_blank" : null}" rel="${d.url.startsWith("http") ? "noopener" : null}">${d.title}</a>
    <span class="wfrc-chip">${d.kind}</span></li>`)}</ul>`;
}
```
